resolved.detail: The public async entry is unchanged; it rejects pre-cancellation, awaits its own synchronously reserved task, forwards caller cancellation, and joins a noncooperative provider. The button calls a distinctly named synchronous entry.

The observable Properties UUID owns retained View reservation and captured callbacks. Closing/reopening, unmount/revoke, and fresh mount retire prior request/result state and cancellation joins the existing document drain. No assumption that SwiftUI destroys State is required.

Independent byte comparison confirms only the exact owned request cleanup predicate/comment changed from v2. Success/error publication guards retain current authority, modal eligibility, request/presentation/document generation and cancellation. Same-request completion releases reservation even if foreground eligibility is transiently false; replacement requests remain protected.
